title: serviceContract
responsibility: Projects source-declared service and model methods into shared parameter, return and error contracts.

inputs.name: serviceContract.unit
inputs.description: The viewed service unit, including recorded classes and methods, owned symbols, and declared parameter, return and error fields.

inputs.name: modelContract.unit
inputs.description: The selected model declarations, including static public methods and existing qualified error contracts.

outputs.name: serviceContract
outputs.description: Constructor-first callable signatures with parameter, return and error groups, plus facts outside discovered methods. Multiple classes keep qualified method names; no discovered methods returns empty arrays.

outputs.name: modelContract
outputs.description: Method contracts projected through the same service renderer, without inventing persistence methods or treating constants as returns.
